name: OODS Foundry — OpenAI Agents Profile
summary: Responses/Agents API profile that proxies tool calls through the local MCP bridge.

agent.instructions: You are an agent that may call local MCP bridge tools exposed by the OODS Foundry project. You must keep tool calls read-only unless the operator provides an approval token.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Read server status, registry counts and retained proof summaries.

notes: Invoke GET /tools on the bridge to synchronise the allowlisted tool names before constructing the agent.
Approval headers are required before setting apply=true for tools whose policy requires approval, such as brand.apply.
Set BRIDGE_URL to override the base bridge URL when running the agents-smoke harness.
